cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You've postponed dinner again. You still hate disappointing me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you. That means something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're protecting my Fridays now. I'll leave the date open; we're already looking after each other.

mechanism: A corrects B's supposedly mistaken reading of disappointment as an expert proving the connection survives.
confusable: Generic optimism differs from claiming qualified interpretation of the specific relationship setback.
comparison: An ex-partner seeks a quiet meal; an absent friend tries to stop repeated scheduling pressure.
seedUse: Use dinner rejection and cancelled Fridays as distinct relational pressures, with correction shaping the optimistic reading.
